description.value: Nesters Market is a Western Canadian full-service supermarket chain founded in Whistler in 1987 and now part of the Pattison Food Group, with locations across BC and Alberta including major tourist destinations like Banff and Jasper. The Lakeview location offers a broad selection including fresh produce, natural and organic products, an in-store bakery, a deli and bistro counter, and a pharmacy. It positions itself as a neighbourhood-focused store with an emphasis on local, specialty, and quality goods that go beyond a typical chain supermarket.
